html:
Our Working Policy

No Advance. No Deposit.
No Long-Term Contract.

You should never have to prepay and hope. At WevTEC – Fix Website Issues, we do the work first, you see the progress, and you pay only after the work is done. Plans are short-term and renew month to month, so you stay because you’re growing, not because you’re locked in.

Get My Free Audit →📞 Call 832-266-7209
Since 2013100+ healthcare practices & law firmsPlans from $750/monthCancel with 7 days’ notice
What we promise

Four Rules We Work By, Every Time

Most agencies ask for money upfront and a 6–12 month commitment before they’ve proven anything. We built our business the other way around.

🚫

No Advance Payment

We don’t charge before the work starts. You pay only after the work is done.

💰

No Deposit

No setup deposits, no retainers held “just in case.” Your money stays yours until you see results of the work.

📅

No Long-Term Contract

Short-term plans that renew month to month. Continue only while the work keeps moving your practice forward.

⏳

Cancel With 7 Days’ Notice

If it’s not working for you, tell us. Seven days’ notice is all we ask, with no penalties.

How it works

How You Move Up and Grow With Us

A simple, low-risk path: start small, see real progress, then scale what works.

1

Free Audit & Consultation

With as little as 1 hour’s notice by Zoom, Google Meet or in person, subject to availability.

2

Clear Plan & Price

We show what’s holding you back and quote the plan that fits. No surprises.

3

We Do the Work

Website fixes, SEO, Google Maps, AI search, Google Ads and social media.

4

You Review, Then Pay

You see the work and the reporting. Payment comes after the work is done.

5

Renew & Scale

Renew month to month, and move up to a bigger plan only when growth justifies it.

Transparent pricing

Healthcare Marketing Plans Start at $750/Month

Every plan is month-to-month with a free website review first. Choose the level that matches your competition and growth goals.

Starter$750/mo

A strong foundation across Google, Maps and AI search.

Basic · Most popular$1,250/mo

Core visibility across Google, Maps, AI search, social media and your website.

Standard$1,500/mo

Stronger SEO growth, expanded AI visibility and a more active social presence.

Advanced$2,000+/mo

For competitive specialties that need aggressive Google, Maps and AI work.

Website fixes start at $50, hacked website repair is $200 and website maintenance starts at $300/month. See full plan details and calculate your cost →

WevTEC vs a typical agency

What Makes Our Policy Different

Explore urgent care → 🚑

Specialty Practices

Explore specialties →
Policy FAQ

Questions About How We Work

Do you require an advance payment or deposit?

No. We don’t take advance payments or deposits. You pay only after the work is done.

Do I have to sign a long-term contract?

No. Our plans are short-term and renew month to month. You continue only while the work keeps helping your practice grow.

How do I cancel?

Give us 7 days’ notice. There are no cancellation penalties.

How much does healthcare marketing cost?

Healthcare marketing plans start at $750/month, with Basic at $1,250, Standard at $1,500 and Advanced from $2,000/month. Website fixes start at $50 and maintenance starts at $300/month.

Can you work with our existing marketing team?

Yes. We can act as an independent SEO, AI search and website partner alongside your current team or marketing consultant.

Will you work with my competitors?

We won’t take on a same-specialty competitor within your specific ZIP codes.

Grow First. Pay After the Work Is Done.

Start with a free audit and an honest plan. No advance, no deposit and no long-term contract.
